candidate: classify only realised focal-positive selected-supply edges before unchanged raw non-adjacent tail96
control: exact frozen confirmed selective plus unique-fullres six-arm fusion final layout
selected_layout: the chosen six-arm pre-tail layout; current/raw/logistic/focal_top5/nonlinear use current supply, selective uses current plus selective-new, combined uses current plus selective-new plus unique-fullres
edge_corpus: only selected-supply focal-logit >= 0 edges already realised by the chosen pre-tail layout

feature_semantics.raw_priority: negative original directional seam cost; lower cost is higher priority
feature_semantics.ranks_and_margins: same raw directional matrices; rank excludes the self tile and margins subtract the best valid outgoing/incoming cost
feature_semantics.provenance: three fixed membership bits in current, selective-new, unique-fullres frozen supply
feature_semantics.arm_support: number/fraction of the six frozen pre-tail layouts which realise the directed edge
feature_semantics.components: undirected components and endpoint degrees over this board's realised focal-positive selected-supply edge corpus
feature_semantics.conflicts: alternative focal-positive selected-supply hypotheses sharing source+axis or target+axis; no competitor uses zero as the fixed reference logit
feature_semantics.incident_conflict_density: sum of the two conflict counts divided by all focal-positive selected-supply hypotheses

model: StandardScaler plus unweighted LogisticRegression(C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=1000, random_state=0)
tail: pass exactly classifier-kept realised edges to unchanged raw non-adjacent max_swaps=96 tail; no candidate-edge construction or seam modification
local_prediction: each validation source receives a model fit only on the other source groups
prohibited_adaptation: edge-source, feature, model, class-weight, threshold, tail-budget, or gate sweep
matcher, denoiser, supply, solver, or pre-tail layout rerun
